office:text.text:h: Overview of the tax calculation process
office:text.text:p: The tax calculation process (arbitrary change here)

The main body of the calculation is contained within stages 1 to 12. Stages 14 to 29 may be required, depending on the taxpayer’s circumstances. They are crossreferenced with various points within stages 1 to 12. Only the end result of processing in stages 14 to 28 (13 is not currently used) are used within stages 1 to 12 but all boxes leading to the end result need to be calculated.

For example: c9.16 requires a figure from box c15.20 or c15.21. To calculate box c15.20 or c15.21 not only requires calculating c15.1 onwards but also c14.1 through c14.6, as these are referenced in c15.6 and c15.7.
The annexes contain associated processing that is dependent on the calculation stages.

Calculation of tax on transition profit – the tax due on the transition profit is the difference between the tax due at step 5 s23 ITA2007 without the transition profit included (c8.25b) and the tax due with it included (c8.25a)
Calculation of tax charge where the customer’s basic rate is lower than the rUK basic rate –
The customer is liable to a tax charge if they have made gift aid payments and their basic rate is lower than the rUK basic rate.
However, the charge cannot be greater than the amount of tax saved by extending the basic rate band, for gift aid payments.
c8.27 calculates the tax which would be due if the basic rate band had not been extended by the gift aid.
The difference between c8.27 and the actual tax due at c8.26 is the tax saving.

office:text.text:h: Annex B – How to Calculate ITFCEGINPUTAMOUNT
office:text.text:p: As a result of there being nonidentical gains from more than one policy there is at least one of the corresponding years’ box absent …
An entry in ITFCEGINPUTAMOUNT (Box 1A) will be required where:
Chargeable Event Gains are present (return box AOI4, return box AOI6, return box AOI8 or return box FOR43) > 0 and either
•Top Slicing Relief may be due i.e. taxpayer liable at Higher rate (Calculation box c17.20 > 0) or

•Capital Gains are present ((CGT6 + CGT13B + CGT13.4 + CGT17 + CGT26 + CGT34) minus ((CGT7 + CGT13.5 + CGT19 + CGT27 + CGT35) minus (CGT41 + CGT43)) + CGT52 + ((CGT52.1 + CGT52.2) minus CGT52.5) > 0) or CGT51 not zero or Null) or (box CGT18 is not zero or null)

As a result of there being nonidentical gains from more than one policy there is at least one of the corresponding years box absent (i.e. AOI4 present and AOI5 absent, or AOI6 present and AOI7 absent, or AOI8 present and AOI9 absent, or FOR43 present and FOR44 absent).
office:text.text:h: How to calculate BOX 1A
office:text.text:p: A= gain arising from each policy relevant to AOI4, AOI6, AOI8 or FOR43
B= years each policy held or years since last gain whichever is the lesser
For each separate instance divide A by B
Add together the result of each instance of A divided by B
If AOI5, AOI7, AOI9 or FOR44 less than 1 substitute 1
